signal: Prove raised $40M led by MassMutual Ventures and Capital One Ventures and launched its Identity Platform as the trust layer for an agentic world

email.body1:
Madison, saw Prove closed $40M and just launched its Identity Platform for an agentic world.

A launch that big usually puts more in-market accounts in play than reps can cover before pipeline expectations catch up, and that is where deals slip. Our AI SDR researches, writes, and follows up on its own, so coverage scales without new headcount: 3-5x more meetings per rep.

I built a personalized signal play for Prove off your hiring and tech-stack signals, and accounts showing them tend to progress about 4.4x faster. Worth 15 minutes for me to walk you through it?
email.body2:
Madison, quick follow-up for Prove.

After a raise this size, the number on pipeline tends to jump faster than the team can. Most groups cannot say exactly how many meetings they need to hit it, so the gap surfaces late and the quarter turns into a scramble to recover.

Want to grab 15 minutes? I will walk you through our pipeline model and show exactly how many meetings Prove needs to hit target this quarter, and where the math breaks if you only add reps to close it.
email.body3:
Madison, last bit of proof for Prove.

Memgraph had more in-market accounts than the team could touch and could not hire SDRs fast enough. They ran our AI SDR to $2.7M in pipeline, 600 replies, and 60 BANT-qualified deals in 90 days, same team, live in four weeks with every email auto-logged to their CRM.

I pulled a benchmark of how Prove's reply rate likely compares to other funded startups. Want to hop on a quick call so I can walk you through it?
email.body4:
Madison, I will stop reaching out on this one, but did not want to leave you empty-handed.

If scaling pipeline without adding headcount is not a priority this quarter, no problem at all. Timing matters right after a raise, and the fundraise-to-scale stretch is its own kind of busy across a sales org.

Before I close your file, worth 15 minutes to walk through a one-page playbook of three AI-SDR plays scoped to your motion? I will tailor it to Prove either way.
